import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

tree = ET.parse("mjcf.xml")
root = tree.getroot()

# Print top-level structure
print("Root tag:", root.tag)
print("Top-level children:", [c.tag for c in root])

# Print worldbody structure (body names, joints, sites)
def print_body_tree(elem, indent=0):
    if elem.tag == "body":
        name = elem.get("name", "(unnamed)")
        joints = [j.get("name","?") for j in elem.findall("joint")]
        sites  = [s.get("name","?") for s in elem.findall("site")]
        print(" "*indent + f"BODY: {name}  joints={joints}  sites={sites}")
        for child in elem:
            print_body_tree(child, indent+2)
    elif elem.tag in ("worldbody",):
        for child in elem:
            print_body_tree(child, indent)

wb = root.find("worldbody")
if wb is not None:
    print_body_tree(wb)
